details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the HIGH importance criteria (K1-K6, K10) with all core material meanings present. K7 (management strategy on retail profitability and store expansion), K8 (inventory and trade receivables changes), and K9 (employee count and salary details) are entirely missing. While the summary is strong on financial performance and geographic breakdown, the absence of these three MEDIUM importance items prevents a perfect score. The overall picture is captured well, but important operational details are omitted.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements are mutually consistent and build upon each other without contradictions. The financial metrics show clear directional changes (increases/decreases) with corresponding margin analyses. The geographic breakdown logically sums to the total revenue mentioned earlier. The narrative flows sequentially from revenue to profitability, geographic performance, operational metrics, and finally to balance sheet and cash flow positions. While some readers might question why certain figures don't arithmetically reconcile (e.g., segment sums vs. total), the candidate itself does not claim these are exhaustive additive components of the same total, so these are not considered internal contradictions per evaluation guidelines. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization follows a logical financial-reporting structure.
